interaction.1v1rules.normal.message:
__**Rules 1v1 Mid only**__ (Basic rules)
:trophy: __Victory__: wins the first player that **destroys** the first **mid tower**, gets **2 kills** or with **more kills** before the time limit.

If the kill score is draw when it gets the time limit, then 2 players must go to the Roshan pit before the 10:40 time mark. The game continues at 11 minute mark. The players can't get out the Roshan pit and have to fight by the kill. If a player attack to the opponent before the 11 minute mark or get the attention of Roshan, the another player wins the game.

:alarm_clock: __Duration:__ 10 minutes

:no_entry: __Not allowed:__
- Runes
- Bottle
- Come back to base
- Sanctuaries
- Hidding to lose time
